answer: Verifier ships each new identity a jetty contract: agent first locks 64 gigabytes of resident RAM holding an atlas of pseudorandom offset tables, then answers probe bursts at pseudo-random addresses inside a 30-nanosecond bus budget measured against a trusted sparrow clock on the verifier's own cache line. Peers replay ten thousand probes per round; any agent missing the budget by even 8 nanoseconds—swap file, cold page, or forged timing signature—gets its round discarded and its standing revoked before attestation weight accrues.
